Subject: Greenhouse / Checkr / Learnio contract renewal — timeline & security evidence

Hi Sophie / Marco / Learnio team,

We're starting the procurement run for our HR stack contracts that expire at the end of Q3. Short summary of what we need from each vendor this week so we can build the renewal packet for Finance & Legal:

- Formal renewal quote with line-item pricing and any available multi-year discount / committed seat pricing
- SOC 2 (or equivalent) report, data processing addendum, and (if available) pen test attestation
- Any proposed contract changes or standard MSA/SOW redlines we should expect
- Target effective date: 2026-10-01 (we can agree on a short extension if needed)

Internal owners: Stephanie (People Ops) will lead scope and budget; Laura (Legal) will handle T&Cs review; Monica (Finance) will confirm budget timing.

Can you confirm receipt and provide the quote + security evidence by EOD Friday (2026-09-03)? If you need to schedule a quick sync, propose times and we'll set up.

Thanks,
Hannah
